title: Typed finite Weil diagrams and pinned finite realization stages
statement: For a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l, and a separated finite-type model Y0, retain the exact normalized classical realization R. A ZlDiagramStage over E is a ZlClassicalPullbackModels witness with finite_pullback, ordinary_unit, classical_objects, finite_unit, stage, stage_pullback_objects and pinning as in R.pullback_pinning, together with the classical natural isomorphism whose values are the equality transports, full faithfulness of finite and its rational addition formula. Typed words have endpoints (i,n), actual n-fold pullback objects and constructors identity, arrow, Weil, inverse, composition and pullback. Expressions are finite lists of integer multiples of these words; evaluate after a specified additive realization. The finite Weil categories are IsoAlgebra of the stage's raw operation; classicalWeil and heartWeil are its natural-isomorphism transports. Define ordinary module Weil maps using the inverse Along comparison. ZlPrescribedWeilLifts quantifies over each finite stage, classical identification beta, arbitrary lisse heart target H, common-stage identification eta and Weil-compatible module isomorphism xi, and asserts a unique common-stage Weil isomorphism with a finite lift psi realizing xi and the stated underlying composite. Coefficient coherence means the witnesses' realization and Along come from one normalized Family with FieldNormalized comparisons. Classical expression equality is equality after every classical geometric fibre functor. All definitions are moved verbatim from the original module.
